comment: Oxidation of syn-pimara-7,15-diene to, sequentially, syn-pimara-7,15-dien-19-ol, syn-pimara-7,15-dien-19-al, and syn-pimara-7,15-dien-19-oic acid. The same behavior with syn-stemod-13(17)-ene

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 added "hydroxylation " and "monooxygenation" to tailoring reaction. Reviewer 2 generalized reaction to minimal common substructure and added second example.

reactions.description: Oxidation of primaradien/stemoden-oic acid core structure.
Oxidation of syn-pimara-7,15-diene to syn-pimara-7,15-dien-19-oic acid.
Oxidation of syn-stemod-13(17)-ene to syn-stemod-13(17)-en-19-oic acid
